description: D2: the Stormcaller standing in the storm on the Bellmere's north shore, leaning on his rod - a world boss held by his territory (world.drowned.stormcaller_territory, TitanTerritory: a giant he sees only discovers the Stormstair; a blow, or a giant climbing into his pools, wakes him; he hunts to 170 m of the pools and walks home whole). From act two (act.two.begun: the storm came when the throne fell). An arena encounter (no leash), its seat reserved within 220 m (reserve_seat) and his AI at the near tier within 420 m (lod_near_m), as the other titans'. He dies once (persist_death; forbids his outcome flag).
